title: ctdR: Chemical enrichment analysis using the Comparative Toxicogenomics Database
description:
ctdR identifies chemicals significantly associated with a set of genes using data from the Comparative Toxicogenomics Database (CTD). It exposes four enrichment frameworks through a single interface (enrichment_CTD()): Over-Representation Analysis (ORA) via clusterProfiler, Gene Set Enrichment Analysis (GSEA) via fgsea, the competitive gene-set test CAMERA via limma, and per-sample Gene Set Variation Analysis (GSVA) via GSVA. The user imports the CTD chemical-gene interactions file once with import_CTD() (or reads it as a CTDFile via the Bioconductor BiocIO import() convention) and then runs enrichment on either a gene list (ORA, GSEA) or an expression matrix (CAMERA, GSVA). Results share a unified output schema, and the CTD gene sets can be exported with as_genesets_CTD() for use with other enrichment engines. The package does not bundle or redistribute CTD data.
